meta.description:
An abandoned Soviet-era research bunker buried beneath bedrock, its concrete chambers lit by failing fluorescent tubes and the cold glow of forgotten
  instruments. A narrow service spine links decontamination, experimental labs, reactor machinery, and a sealed command center.

layout.description:
An abandoned Soviet-era research bunker buried beneath bedrock, its concrete chambers lit by failing fluorescent tubes and the cold glow of forgotten
  instruments. A narrow service spine links decontamination, experimental labs, reactor machinery, and a sealed command center.

rooms.name: Intake Airlock
rooms.style: A compressed entry chamber with heavy rounded blast doors, wet concrete walls, corroded pipework, and flickering fluorescent fixtures. Furnish it as a grim personnel checkpoint.

rooms.name: Decontamination Bay
rooms.style: A narrow wash-down room with rust-stained tiled walls, drainage channels, shower arches, and abandoned protective equipment. Its forms should feel clinical but decayed.

rooms.name: Service Spine
rooms.style: A long, claustrophobic maintenance corridor lined with cable conduits, rusted valves, dented utility cabinets, and intermittent fluorescent tubes. It is the bunker’s utilitarian circulation backbone.

rooms.name: Turbine Hall
rooms.style: A broad machinery chamber dominated by silent superquadric turbines, pressure tanks, red warning housings, and oily grated flooring. Rust and soot should collect around every massive assembly.

rooms.name: Specimen Ward
rooms.style: A cramped medical observation room with old steel examination tables, glass-fronted specimen cabinets, cracked mint-green panels, and fallen fluorescent housings. It should suggest hurried abandonment after a containment failure.
